lead.label: 1f
lead.why: The abstract names no compound (methodology paper). Rule 2: 1f is the model product of the optimisation (Table 1), the 10 mmol large-scale run (92%), the catalyst-recycling runs and the GC-MS mechanism study ('the synthesis of 2-amino-3-cyano-4-(4-chlorophenyl)-7,7-dimethyl-5-oxo-5,6,7,8-tetrahydro-4H-benzopyran (1f) was studied').

reactions.conditions: One-pot three-component reaction; aldehyde (1 mmol), malononitrile (1.1 mmol), dimedone (1 mmol), piperazine (10 mg, ~11 mol%, catalyst) in water (2-3 mL), 90 C (Method A) or 30 mg piperazine at room temperature (Method B); product filtered and washed with cold water. Scale-up: 10 mmol, 15 mol% piperazine, rt, 2.5 h, 92%.
reactions.source: Main text sections 2.2 (general procedure), 3 (results: optimisation, large scale, mechanism), Table 1 and Table 2 entry 6

notes: Methodology paper; the lead is chosen by rule 2 as the paper's model reaction product. All 1f-type products are racemic (stereocentre at C4 not specified). Aldehyde, malononitrile and dimedone are purchased (Fluka, Merck, Aldrich). Printed name of 1f appears in two forms in the text; both are given. The one-pot Knoevenagel/Michael/cyclisation is counted as one step as the paper reports it as one procedure.
